The deeper numbers: one tester saw CPMs above $65 after nearly $70,000 spent. Click-through is 0.91% versus 6.4% on Google Search. Median cost per click across 15 campaigns is $4.41.

My take: measure whether AI cites you before you decide how much to spend on media.

scenes: This morning: ChatGPT Ads reached 89 countries, and over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns. I went back in to check what those advertisers actually pay and get.
First, one advertiser spent nearly $70,000 testing ChatGPT Ads and saw CPMs above $65. His bigger worry was low click-through.
Second, Adthena data puts ChatGPT ad click-through at 0.91%. Google Search sits at 6.4%, so people click far less often.
Third, a review of 15 published campaigns found a median click costs $4.41. The spread is wide, from $0.76 to $14.80.
My take: clicks cost real money and results vary widely. Measure whether AI already cites you before paying to be seen.
